page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 7H12 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance. The lack of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing raw CPU execution capacity and high-density compute resources over local disk I/O or hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a dense compute profile for parallelizable workloads without the overhead of unneeded memory or GPU hardware. This configuration is designed for compute-heavy workloads such as high-performance computing, batch processing, scientific modeling, large-scale web serving, and distributed analytics that require significant CPU cores but have moderate memory footprints.
